question: Where can I get annual agricultural crop production statistics in Spain, by crop and territory, with production volume, crop area, yield and historical series?

answer.summary: MAPA is the official source. Its 2025 provisional workbooks by crop group give national, comunidad and province tables plus a long-format database (sown, cultivated and harvested area; harvested production; provincial yields for secano and regadío). The Anuario de Estadística 2025, chapter 7, holds the consolidated 2024 data and series from 2014. The July 2026 monthly advance gives provisional 2026 cereal estimates. Eurostat's national and NUTS 2 series and the ESYRCE area survey cross-check the figures. MAPA documents its municipal crop-area survey as not disseminated (IME 2014); Catalonia publishes municipal woody-crop areas as open data.
main_caveats: 2025 figures are provisional. MAPA says the Anuario consolidates them; 2024 is the consolidated edition.
Olive national TOTAL row yields (1,427 and 4,069 kg/ha) repeat in 2024 and 2025 and do not match production over harvested area. Compute yields from the tables.
Yields reproduce as production over harvested area (checked for cereals, olive, Jaén, Spain). The 2013 notes define yield over cultivated area.
The olive series changes in 2023: double-purpose groves are added and harvested area is redefined. Do not splice across 2023 without adjustment.
MAPA's IME (2014) says municipal crop areas are not disseminated. Catalonia's municipal open data covers woody crops, as area only (no tonnes or yields).
Eurostat's Spanish 2025 production is about 3% below MAPA's provisional figure (Castilla y León 3.9%). For 2024 the two agree within 0.1%.
answer.confidence_reason: Core figures were recomputed from the official files (national sums match the tables; yields reproduce). Unresolved: 2025 provisional status, olive national yield cells, and the Eurostat 2025 gap.

attributes.note: Crop codes and names in the BD and Anuario tables (e.g. CE1110 soft and semi-hard wheat, OL1000 total olive grove). Olive oil kept apart from harvested olives.
Spain without Ceuta and Melilla: national, comunidad aggregates and 50 provinces in the MAPA BD. No municipal release documented (IME 2014).
Harvest year: 2025 provisional, 2024 consolidated, 2026 monthly estimate; wheat and olive series 2014-2024; Eurostat 2000-2025.
Harvested grain and olives in tonnes by province; olive oil in tonnes as processed output (2024: 1,401,354 t; 2025 provisional: 1,294,649 t).
Hectares sown, cultivated and harvested (cereals); olive grove planted, in production and harvested. ESYRCE gives survey areas by province.
kg/ha by province for secano and regadío on harvested area (verified). National totals must be computed; olive national summary cells do not reproduce.

sources.name: Superficies y producciones anuales de cultivos: datos provisionales de la campaña 2025 (ficheros por grupo de cultivos)
sources.publisher: Ministerio de Agricultura, Pesca y Alimentación (MAPA), Subdirección General de Análisis, Coordinación y Estadística
sources.format: XLSX, one workbook per crop group; each workbook embeds the full long-format BD sheet (914,700 data rows, all crop groups)
sources.summary: Harvest-year 2025 provisional crop statistics by province for all crop groups: sown, cultivated and harvested area, harvested production, and yields by secano and regadío.
sources.coverage_note: Spain excluding Ceuta and Melilla: national, comunidad and 50 provinces. No municipal data.
caveats: 2025 is provisional until the Anuario consolidates it
National olive yield cells do not reproduce; compute yields from production and harvested area

problems: Figures are labelled provisional for campaign 2025 (file title and MAPA page).
TOTAL OLIVAR national yields (1427 and 4069 kg/ha) do not reproduce production over harvested area from the same row (about 2,400 and 5,476 kg/ha).
Each crop-group workbook embeds the full BD sheet (about 464 MB uncompressed).
The MAPA page shows no publication date; the workbook metadata 'modified' dates are 2026-10-23 (cereals) and 2026-10-28 (olive).

example.example_request: Workbook re1_cereales_formato_tabla_global_25.xlsx, sheet 'BD_HORTALIZAS-NO' (xl/worksheets/sheet3.xml). Keep rows where PRO_ID (column A) = 47, CSP_DCW_AB1234 (column F) = CE1110 and CSP_DCW_TXYZ (column H) = SCOT. Read the value in column J.
example.example_result: Valladolid, CE1110, SCOT = 123505 ha (2025 provisional); PCOG = 698857 t. Sum over PRO_ID 1-50 of SCOT = 1795163 ha, equal to the national row of TABLA GLOBAL NACIONAL.

sources.name: Anuario de Estadística 2025, capítulo 7: Superficies y producciones de cultivos (datos 2024 consolidados y series históricas)
sources.publisher: Ministerio de Agricultura, Pesca y Alimentación (MAPA)
sources.format: XLSX (chapter 07, 540 sheets, about 9 MB) plus a chapter PDF and a methodology PDF
sources.summary: Consolidated 2024 national, comunidad and province tables for cereals, legumes, olives and other groups, plus national series from 2014 (wheat and olive).
sources.coverage_note: Spain excluding Ceuta and Melilla; comunidad and province rows for 2024; series at national level.
caveats: Olive national summary yields do not reproduce
Olive series changes in 2023; check the block labels before use

problems: National olive summary yields (1427 and 4069) do not reproduce; the national row of sheet 7.12.1.1 gives 2,483 and 6,065 kg/ha.
Block label mismatch in sheet 7.12.1.5: the first block is headed 'ACEITUNA DE ALMAZARA' but carries total olive grove values in 2024.
The MAPA methodology (IME 2014, notes 2013) predates the 2025 format; it defines yield over cultivated area, which the 2025 files do not follow.

example.example_request: Workbook AE25-C07.xlsx, sheet '7.1.2.6.1 Trigo semiduro y blando: Análisis provincial detallado, 2024' (xl/worksheets/sheet16.xml). Read the row 'Valladolid' or 'ESPAÑA'; columns: Superficie cosechada Total, Rendimiento superficie cosechada Secano and Regadío, Producción cosechada Grano.
example.example_result: Valladolid 2024: harvested area 121508 ha; yield 4089 kg/ha (secano) and 6677 kg/ha (regadío); harvested grain 548930 t. ESPAÑA 2024: 1678551 ha; 3487 and 5653 kg/ha; 6368889 t.

The June 'Excel' links resolve to PDFs

The 2025 base differs from the 2025 provisional workbook (see reading traps).
No olive or woody-crop estimates in the July 2026 cuaderno.

example.example_request: pdftotext -layout 'Avances julio 2026.pdf' avances.txt, then find the row beginning 'Trigo blando' in the summary table ('Avances mensuales de superficies y producciones agrícolas').
example.example_result: Trigo blando: 2026 advance 1,693.4 thousand ha (94,5 % of 2025) and 5,579.8 thousand t (72,0 %), against 2025 provisional 1,791.0 thousand ha and 7,755.0 thousand t.

example.example_result: Valladolid 2025 (survey): total 131,165.24 ha (secano 117,536.35; regadío 13,628.89). Sheet 'CASTILLA Y LEON': 866,065.64 ha. National PDF row: 1,790,362 ha.

sources.name: Crop production in national humidity by NUTS 2 regions [apro_cpnhr] (Eurostat)
sources.publisher: Eurostat (European Commission statistical office), compiled from the national submissions of Spain
sources.format: JSON-stat (API response; 74,489 bytes for Spain, geo=ES)
sources.summary: Eurostat's national and NUTS 2 series for common wheat (area, harvested production, yield), 2000 to 2025. Cross-checks MAPA national totals.
sources.coverage_note: Spain and NUTS 2 regions; crop codes such as C1110. No olive. Yields only for some crops and years.
caveats: Yield denominator (sown area) and humidity basis differ from MAPA
2025 production is about 3% below MAPA's provisional figure

problems: No olive category in this table.
The NUTS 2 query for ES41 (3,574 bytes) returns area and production only, 6 values for 2023-2025, and no yield.

example.example_request: curl -sL 'https://ec.europa.eu/eurostat/api/dissemination/statistics/1.0/data/apro_cpnhr?format=JSON&lang=EN&geo=ES' -o apro_cpnhr-ES.json. Decode the 'value' dictionary using the dimension sizes (time varies fastest).
example.example_result: Spain, C1110, 2024: area 1717.46 thousand ha; harvested production 6372.81 thousand t; yield 3.71 t/ha. 2025: area 1820.59; production 7550.84; yield null.

if_unstructured.summary: MAPA's municipal crop-area survey (1TM, since 1975) is documented as not disseminated (IME 2014). The only municipal open data found is Catalonia's woody-crop CSV (area only).

local_terms.meaning: Sown area (SSTO total, SSSE secano, SSRE regadío)
Sown area after harvest, excluding destroyed areas (IME definition); SCUT in the tables
Harvested area (SCOT); the denominator of the published yields, as reproduced in the checks
Yield in kg/ha (RSCS secano, RSCR regadío); olive series in qm/ha
Crop season labelled by its harvest year (año de recolección)
Harvested production (PCOG grain; PTRE olive harvest); PRNC is unharvested production
Olives for oil / table olives (OL1200 / OL1100 in the BD); olive groves split the same way
Rainfed / irrigated; areas and yields are split by regime
